body.x: Ceragem announced on the 23rd that it will participate in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and technology exhibition, to be held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9, 2026 (local time).

The Consumer Technology Association (CTA), which hosts CES, highlighted how smart home technologies and products selected for the CES 2026 Innovation Awards are transforming everyday life. CTA also underscored the value of technologies that evolve residential spaces into more personalized, responsive, and proactive environments.

Against this backdrop, Ceragem drew attention by earning 12 CES 2026 Innovation Awards, the highest number in the healthcare sector. This marks a fourfold increase compared with its results at CES 2024, which was the company’s first participation in the exhibition.

In particular, Ceragem received strong recognition for its technological approach that goes beyond device-centric healthcare and transforms the entire living space into an integrated health management system. The award-winning products, including the Master AI Multi Therapy Pod, Home Therapy Booth 2.0 AI, Medispa Pro AI, and Balance Mediwater AI, share the characteristic of blending seamlessly into everyday spaces such as living rooms, bedrooms, private rooms, and bathrooms.

At CES 2026, Ceragem will present its exhibition booth under the theme “A living, breathing home that knows me best,” introducing the concept of an “AI Wellness Home.” Through this concept, the company plans to showcase experiences in which smart healthcare products connect organically across three lifestyle zones, offering customized healthcare experiences tailored to different age groups.

For example, spaces designed for children and families will reflect growth-stage physical rhythms and daily life patterns. At the same time, areas for young and middle-aged adults will present wellness solutions that naturally integrate everyday health management and recovery.

Spaces dedicated to the silver generation will encompass both physical health management and emotional care in later life, creating home healthcare experiences that add stability and calm to daily living. Through these settings, Ceragem aims to present a future residential environment that understands the daily lives of family members throughout the home and proposes optimized solutions accordingly.

Ceragem will also create a dedicated area where visitors can experience its personalized healthcare platform, “CeraCheck.” In this so-called “CeraCheck Zone,” the company will introduce its vision for a healthcare platform that integrates the entire health management process, from measurement and analysis to personalized care, into a single, unified experience.

A Ceragem representative said, “At CES 2026, Ceragem will offer visitors an early opportunity to experience how the home evolves into a living wellness space,” adding, “As healthcare expands beyond individual products to focus on spaces and everyday life, we plan to highlight the potential of residential healthcare solutions proposed by Ceragem.”

Meanwhile, Ceragem will operate its exhibition booth on the second floor, Halls A through D, of the Venetian Expo at CES 2026, where it will also run consultation areas for buyers and investors, as well as dedicated experience zones.
